description: This file is a C++ header for the RDKLoggerAgent class, defining its interface, methods, and includes. It declares the class which implements logging-related functionalities through a set of RPC methods, including initialization, logging different levels, environment access, and log level management.

classes.name: RDKBLoggerAgent
classes.description: A class implementing RPC server methods for RDK Logger, providing logging initialization, control, configuration retrieval, and message logging functionalities.
